content: Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP is provided as a sterile crystalline powder packaged in glass vials. The available packaging options are as follows: 1. Bulk Pharmacy Containers: These containers contain 10 grams of ceftriaxone equivalent. They are supplied in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-0679-5). Note: This packaging is not intended for direct administration. Other package sizes are also available. 2. Vials Containing 250 mg of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Available in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-0750-0). Also available in a box of 10 (NDC 60505-0750-4). 3. Vials Containing 500 mg of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Available in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-0751-0). Also available in a box of 10 (NDC 60505-0751-4). 4. Vials Containing 1 gram of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Available in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-0752-0). Also available in a box of 10 (NDC 60505-0752-4). 5. Vials Containing 2 grams of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Available in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-0753-0). Also available in a box of 10 (NDC 60505-0753-4). 6. Piggyback Bottles Containing 1 gram of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Supplied in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-6087-1). 7. Piggyback Bottles Containing 2 grams of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Supplied in a box of 1 (NDC 60505-6088-1). Storage Instructions: Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP sterile powder should be stored at a temperature range of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). Trademark Note: Flagyl® is a registered trademark of G.D. Searle LLC.
